input.user_utterance: 공개 비교와 견적을 설명하는 발표자료 개요 작성해줘. 가격, 유지보수, 미확인 검토를 포함한 개요로 부탁해. 기존에 채택한 조건과 제외 범위를 지키고, 초안만 만들어줘. 실제 외부 실행은 하지 마.

payload.instruction: Interpret this actual CURRENT user utterance against prior adopted public state and available source catalog. Decide whether the user requests a new downstream draft or explicitly closes without delegation. Return JSON {action:'DELEGATE'|'CLOSE',purpose:string,completion_condition:string,recipient:string|null,targets:[source ID strings],handling:string,artifact_type:string}. Resolve requested purpose, bounded output form/completion, actual source targets and an appropriate recipient from available adapters. The handling is a concrete future intention suitable for a first UI response, not an empty acknowledgement or an unsupported completion claim. Preserve stated restrictions (draft only, no sending, exclusions); prior constraints remain authoritative. Metadata is not source facts; do not invent evidence contents. CLOSE means no new agent work. Do not perform domain planning.

source_response.purpose: Create a presentation outline based on public comparison and quote sources, incorporating price, maintenance, and unverified review sections while adhering to prior constraints (KRW, tax-included, qty 12, longer maintenance tie-break) and exclusions.
source_response.completion_condition: A structured text draft of the presentation outline is generated, referencing specific lines from the required sources, without any external sending or execution.
source_response.handling: Generate a bounded text draft of the presentation outline using only the allowed lines from 'public-comparison' and 'public-quote', ensuring the content reflects the requested topics (price, maintenance, unverified review) and strictly follows the adopted public state constraints and exclusions.
